newsitem.title: DUBAI: U.S. helicopter crew survive crash in Gulf.
newsitem.headline: U.S. helicopter crew survive crash in Gulf.

text.p: Three U.S. Navy members have been rescued after their helicopter crashed in the Gulf of Aden, a U.S. Navy statement said.

The statement, issued late on Wednesday by the U.S. Naval Central Command in the Gulf, said the SH-60 Seahawk helicopter was on a routine mission when it crashed in waters off Yemen and Somalia. The helicopter operated from the destroyer USS Nicholson.
One crew member suffered minor injuries. The other two were unharmed.
"An investigation will be conducted to determine the cause of the accident," said the statement.
